Generated from SDK TypeScript declarations/JSDoc and component definitions. Run `npm run build` to refresh. Do not edit this file.

Authoring contract: 1.2.0. Markup returns HTML strings; mounting is frontend-only and never requests backend capabilities.

```typescript
type UICloseReason = 'confirm' | 'cancel' | 'escape' | 'programmatic' | 'dismiss' | 'destroy';
```

```typescript
type UIState = Readonly<{ open: boolean; destroyed: boolean; pending: boolean; error: string | null; closeReason: UICloseReason | null }>;
```

```typescript
type UIDiagnostic = { code: string; message: string; detail?: string };
```

```typescript
type UIStyleOptions = Partial<Pick<DOMOptions, 'classes' | 'style'>>;
```

```typescript
type PopoverPlacement = 'bottom-start' | 'bottom-end' | 'top-start' | 'top-end';
```

```typescript
type ProgressBarState = Readonly<{ value: number | null; max: number; destroyed: boolean }>;
```

```typescript
type ToastVariant = 'info' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'error';
```

```typescript
type ToastCloseReason = 'dismiss' | 'timeout' | 'programmatic' | 'destroy';
```

```typescript
type ToastState = Readonly<{
    open: boolean;
    destroyed: boolean;
    paused: boolean;
    variant: ToastVariant;
    closeReason: ToastCloseReason | null;
    progress: ProgressBarState | null;
}>;
```

```typescript
type InlineAlertState = Readonly<{ visible: boolean; variant: ToastVariant; destroyed: boolean }>;
```

```typescript
type ToastRegionState = Readonly<{
    destroyed: boolean;
    entries: ReadonlyArray<Readonly<{ key: string; status: 'visible' | 'queued' }>>;
}>;
```

```typescript
type AsyncActionPhase = 'idle' | 'pending' | 'success' | 'error' | 'cancelled';
```

```typescript
type AsyncActionButtonState = Readonly<{ phase: AsyncActionPhase; error: string | null; disabled: boolean; destroyed: boolean }>;
```

```typescript
type TabsState = Readonly<{ activeKey: string; destroyed: boolean }>;
```

```typescript
type DisclosureState = Readonly<{ open: boolean; destroyed: boolean }>;
```

```typescript
type AccordionState = Readonly<{ openKeys: ReadonlyArray<string>; destroyed: boolean }>;
```
